generator.mode: pixels placed by code from the briefs below; no generative image model and no input image

spec.outline: 2 source px (1 logical px) of #120d16, like the unit frames
spec.band: 2 source px of the state color inside the outline
spec.liquid_mask: d{N}_liquid.png: white pixels of the glass inside the band; the runtime cuts it by height and multiplies the success or failure color
spec.numbers: none in the pictures; the runtime draws them beside the die (docs/design/combat/dice-presentation.md)

states.brief: Original pixel-art die body, transparent background: neutral cream band, dark glass, no liquid, a ring of small spin-trail pixels around the body.
Same body with a success-green band and dark glass. The liquid is added at runtime.
Same body with a failure-red band and dark glass. The liquid is added at runtime.
Same body with a gold band, warm dark glass and short light rays above. The runtime fills it with success liquid.
Same body with a dark purple band, very dark glass, a gold crack line and a few shard pixels below. The runtime leaves a single row of failure liquid.
